sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. Treat this as an early planning picture, not a promise about live service. The result rests on assumptions your architect should review before money or commitments.

The workload estimate is 8 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_B200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_H200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The workload estimate and the chosen factory size are separate ideas. Spare room exists in the plan, but it does not tell us how many customers could use it.

Required memory per GPU: 58.359738 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 2048 GB. Host local disk provision: 30720 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Compare working memory per device with the demand, not just the total. The host memory and local disk figures are planning inputs rather than measured results.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. Shared storage capacity is still open, so it should not be read as no need. Data held outside the factory is not copied in unless that step is planned.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering from the customer side and communication between GPUs remain open questions. Treat external and internal flow descriptions as separate views, not volumes to add.

Review assumptions and outstanding measurements with the architect. Prepare or use the saved design handoff together with its companion requirements. Provide the initial customer-datacenter data volume and allowed transfer window. Ongoing bulk transfers are unspecified. Daily-volume rates are averages over 24 hours, not measured burst rates. Measure aggregate storage read and write throughput. Storage capacity alone does not determine fabric bandwidth. East-west per-GPU port demand needs the selected reference design and collective-communication measurements. Customer-datacenter round-trip latency objective is unspecified. A saved projection exists. Fields marked brief_only must be applied separately by the architect. Review assumptions and open measurements with the architect, who must separate requirements from design decisions. Use the saved handoff and collect the missing traffic and storage details.
